req031.mutation_harness:
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT = Path('/home/openclaw/.openclaw/workspace/ai-family')
PACKAGE = ROOT / 'toolsets/iot/home-device-fabric/src/home_device_fabric'
source = (PACKAGE / 'ha_discovery.py').read_text()
mutations = [
    ('read-only-command', source.replace('"config/device_registry/list"',
                                        '"config/device_registry/update"'),
     'test_complete_bundle_command_order_and_repeat_calls'),
    ('authentication-rejection', source.replace('if auth.get("type") == "auth_invalid":',
                                               'if False:'),
     'test_authentication_and_transport_failures_never_send_commands'),
    ('result-id', source.replace('or result["id"] != identifier', 'or False'),
     'test_strict_wire_validation'),
    ('record-identity-uniqueness', source.replace('if identifier in seen:', 'if False:'),
     'test_records_are_validated_before_publication'),
    ('frame-byte-bound', source.replace('if len(raw.encode("utf-8")) > limit:', 'if False:'),
     'test_strict_wire_validation'),
    ('record-count-bound', source.replace('if len(value) > limit:', 'if False:'),
     'test_records_are_validated_before_publication'),
    ('cleanup-success-rejection', source.replace('if code is None:\n                        code, stage = "cleanup_failed", "cleanup"',
                                                'if False:\n                        code, stage = "cleanup_failed", "cleanup"'),
     'test_cleanup_failure_rejects_success_without_masking_primary'),
    ('private-exception-context', source.replace('except (OSError, EOFError):\n            code = "transport_failed"',
        'except (OSError, EOFError) as original:\n            raise HADiscoveryError("transport_failed", stage, completed) from original'),
     'test_authentication_and_transport_failures_never_send_commands'),
    ('concurrency-admission', source.replace('if self._worker is not None:\n            raise HADiscoveryError("client_busy")',
                                           'if False:\n            raise HADiscoveryError("client_busy")'),
     'test_busy_close_and_discover_after_close'),
    ('deadline-reset', source.replace('for identifier, (stage, command) in enumerate(zip(_COMPONENTS, _COMMANDS), 1):',
        'for identifier, (stage, command) in enumerate(zip(_COMPONENTS, _COMMANDS), 1):\n'
        '                    deadline = asyncio.get_running_loop().time() + self._configuration.request_timeout_ms / 1000'),
     'test_deadline_is_shared_across_commands'),
    ('raw-snapshot-repr', source.replace('return "HADiscoverySnapshot(<redacted>)"',
                                       'return repr(self._payloads)'),
     'test_complete_bundle_command_order_and_repeat_calls'),
    ('escaped-surrogates', source.replace('        key.encode("utf-8")  # JSON escapes must not smuggle unpaired surrogates.\n', '').replace(
        '        elif type(item) is str:\n            item.encode("utf-8")\n', ''),
     'test_json_escaped_surrogates_are_not_retained'),
]
report = {'runtime_sha256': hashlib.sha256(source.encode()).hexdigest(), 'mutations': []}
for name, changed, selection in mutations:
    assert changed != source, name
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='req031-mutation-') as tmp:
        package = Path(tmp) / 'home_device_fabric'
        shutil.copytree(PACKAGE, package, ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns('__pycache__'))
        (package / 'ha_discovery.py').write_text(changed)
        env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONPATH=tmp, PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD='1')
        probe = subprocess.run(['/tmp/req019-env/bin/python', '-c',
                                'import home_device_fabric.ha_discovery as d; print(d.__file__)'],
                               env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, cwd='/tmp', check=True)
        assert probe.stdout.startswith(tmp)
        command = ['/tmp/req019-env/bin/python', '-m', 'pytest', '-c',
                   str(ROOT / 'toolsets/iot/home-device-fabric/pytest.ini'),
                   str(ROOT / 'toolsets/iot/home-device-fabric/tests/test_ha_discovery.py'),
                   '-k', selection, '--require-ha-discovery-runtime', '-q', '--tb=short']
        result = subprocess.run(command, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True,
                                timeout=30, cwd='/tmp')
        log = result.stdout + result.stderr
        Path('/tmp/req031-mutation-' + name + '.log').write_text(log)
        assert result.returncode == 1 and ' failed' in result.stdout, name + '\n' + log
        item = {'name': name, 'test': selection, 'exit_code': result.returncode,
                'summary': result.stdout.strip().splitlines()[-1],
                'mutant_sha256': hashlib.sha256(changed.encode()).hexdigest(),
                'log_sha256': hashlib.sha256(log.encode()).hexdigest()}
        report['mutations'].append(item)
        print(name, item['summary'], flush=True)
Path('/tmp/req031-mutations.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2)+'\n')
